intended_use: Five full title/abstract translation samples; metadata verification against AEA publisher pages; no import.
selection: Explicit five-DOI pilot, all AER candidates with non-empty abstracts; excludes Presidential Address; purposive not random.
comparison_method: Assistant compared all five AEA article pages to local originals, preserving author order. Publisher abbreviated page ranges expanded for comparison. JEL codes compared to publisher JEL Classification separately; display paragraphs normalized conceptually. This is a manual text comparison, not an automated HTML diff or independent expert review.

rows.title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
rows.translation_review: 复核重点：四分之三是管理者自述的比例；“准随机”没有改成随机试验；绩效薪酬、团队规模和人才可见度均保留为代理指标。“首次”是原摘要中的作者表述，本次没有另行核验文献优先权。

rows.title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World's Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
rows.translation_review: 复核重点：敏感程度是 2–3 倍，不是“高出 2–3 倍”；候车时间与乘车时间没有混淆；“对较长线路关注不足”没有改写成不愿乘坐；网络变化的结果保留为研究推断。作者姓名差异已记录，未直接改库。

rows.title: Remote Work and City Structure
rows.translation_review: 复核重点：通勤出行稳定在疫情前的 60%，不是下降 60%；2.3% 指福利损失，不是 GDP 降幅；“可能导致”和“多重稳态均衡”均保留。此处只翻译摘要，不把研究结论扩展到所有城市。

rows.title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
rows.translation_review: 复核重点：个人经济考量没有误写成腐败；“逮捕质量”保留原词，不自行补充犯罪严重程度或定罪率等衡量标准；一阶影响不等于“统计显著”。

rows.title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms' Subjective Beliefs
rows.translation_review: 复核重点：主观不确定性与条件波动性没有混同；企业特有的不确定性没有误写成全体企业共同受到的冲击；用工和价格是管理者的计划，不是已经实现的变化。

findings.evidence: Jakarta local/OpenAlex Benjamin Olken; Crossref and AEA Benjamin A. Olken.
findings.cause: paperMerge.quality scores entire author lists, including ORCID bonuses; choose takes OpenAlex's list. It does not independently prefer a publisher-aligned fuller name per author.
findings.risk: Incomplete bibliographic display; does not invalidate DOI or abstract translation.
findings.next: Preserve originals now. In a separately scoped code change, add regression coverage and source-backed author-name resolution without merging uncertain identities.

findings.evidence: All five local online dates empty, print dates encoded YYYY-MM-01; AEA article pages confirm issue month only.
findings.risk: A first-of-month value must not be presented as a verified online-first day.
findings.next: Report only month/volume/issue here. Confirm date precision from source fields before changing date storage or daily presentation.

limitations: Only five purposively selected AER papers were checked; not all 487 records or all AER papers.
No paper full text, model replication, empirical accuracy, universal publication priority, completeness, or exhaustive retraction search was verified.
No new collection; only 2026-09-08 source snapshot available, so no trend inference.
Translation produced and reviewed by the same assistant, not an independent academic translator.
